rows.note: Use this for the clothing item, especially the casual polo-collar shirt.

example.english: I want to buy a polo shirt to wear to work.
example.traditional: 我想買件馬球恤返工着。

rows.note: Use this for the horseback ball sport; it is the all-purpose term for that sport.

example.english: I tried playing polo with other people when I was young.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣試過同人打馬球。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si3 gwo3 tung4 jan4 daa2 maa5 kau4
